تفتتحون (form VIII)
# تَفْتَتِحُونَ (taftatiḥūna) /taf.ta.ti.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
# تُفْتَتَحُونَ (tuftataḥūna) /tuf.ta.ta.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
